'''Sanv K'la''' is a [[draenei]] [[quest giver]] in the [[Harborage]] in the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. A member of the [[Tribe of Sanv]]<ref name="Learn Of My Past" />, he is the leader of the draenei exiles of the Harborage. Along with part of his tribe and [[Lost Ones|another tribe]] of Draenei, he fled the dying world of [[Draenor]] with the [[riftwalker]] [[Akh Z'ador]] on the command of his chieftain, [[Sanv Tas'dal]], after the destruction wrought by the [[orcish Horde]].

Welcome to Harborage, outsider, my name is Sanv'Kla, the leader of this place.

I guide my people to a better fate away from the hellish landscape we once called home.

Perhaps this is home now, and for the better.

The Draenei here are friendly and will treat you with respect.
